Manga 'Ochikobore Fruit Tart' Concludes With 9th Volume
The official X account for author Sou Hamayumiba announced on Wednesday that the Ochikobore Fruit Tart (Dropout Idol Fruit Tart) manga is ending with the ninth volume. The series concluded its magazine serialization in the September 2026 issue of Manga Time Kirara Carat on July 28, followed by the digital release of its 123rd and final chapter on August 1.
